visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A figure wearing a full-body Spider-Man costume and mask stands on what appears to be a high-rise balcony at night. The character has long brown hair trailing from beneath the mask, standing in a side-profile view. The background is a dark urban skyline dominated by the Taipei 101 skyscraper, illuminated with multi-colored lights. Stylized white lightning-bolt animations flicker across the frame periodically. (2) A visual transition occurs where a secondary, semi-transparent layer of the character appears to pull the mask off. (3) The mask is removed to reveal a young woman with long, flowing brown hair. She is wearing the red and blue superhero suit from the neck down. She smiles brightly at the camera, tilting her head and performing a hair flip while posing against the city lights. The lighting on her face is warm and soft, contrasting with the dark, cool-toned city background.

It uses the visual hook of a masked superhero character against a famous city landmark (Taipei 101) to pique interest, followed by a synchronized transition reveal of the creator's face to engage the audience through beauty and cosplay appeal.
